```html
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>Add Todo</title>
    <link href="{{ asset('css/app.css') }}" rel="stylesheet">
    <script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@alpinejs/core"></script>
    <script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@alpinejs/tailwind"></script>
    <script src="https://unpkg.com/livewire@2.x/dist/livewire.js"></script>
</head>
<body class="bg-gray-100 font-sans antialiased">
    <div wire:ignore.self class="max-w-md mx-auto p-4 rounded shadow-lg">
        <h2 class="text-xl font-bold mb-4">Add Todo</h2>

        <form wire:submit.prevent="addTodo" enctype="multipart/form-data">
            <div class="mb-6">
                <label for="title" class="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700">Title</label>
                <input type="text" id="title" name="title" wire:model="title" required class="mt-1 block w-full px-4 py-2 border border-gray-300 rounded-md shadow-sm focus:outline-none focus:border-blue-500">
            </div>

            <div class="mb-6">
                <label for="description" class="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700">Description</label>
                <textarea id="description" name="description" wire:model="description" required class="mt-1 block w-full px-4 py-2 border border-gray-300 rounded-md shadow-sm focus:outline-none focus:border-blue-500"></textarea>
            </div>

            @if ($image)
                <div class="mb-6">
                    <label for="image" class="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700">Image</label>
                    <input type="file" id="image" name="image" wire:model="image" required class="mt-1 block w-full px-4 py-2 border border-gray-300 rounded-md shadow-sm focus:outline-none focus:border-blue-500">
                </div>
            @endif

            <button type="submit" class="inline-block px-6 py-2 bg-blue-500 text-white font-semibold rounded-lg hover:bg-blue-700 focus:outline-none focus:ring-blue-800">Add Todo</button>
        </form>

        <div wire:if="$message" class="mt-4">
            <div class="bg-green-100 border-t border-l border-r text-green-600 px-4 py-3 relative flex items-center justify-between">
                <div class="flex items-center">
                    <svg class="fill-current w-4 h-4 mr-2" viewBox="0 0 20 20"><path d="M9.875 16H11V16L12.5 17V13H14.5V13L16 14H14V14L12.5 15V14H9.875Z"></path></svg>
                    <span class="font-semibold">{{ $message }}</span>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>

        @if ($errors->any())
            <div class="mt-4">
                <div class="bg-red-100 border-t border-l border-r text-red-600 px-4 py-3 relative flex items-center justify-between">
                    <div class="flex items-center">
                        <svg class="fill-current w-4 h-4 mr-2" viewBox="0 0 20 20"><path d="M9.875 16H11V16L12.5 17V13H14.5V13L16 14H14V14L12.5 15V14H9.875Z"></path></svg>
                        <span class="font-semibold">{{ $errors->first() }}</span>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
        @endif
    </div>

    <script>
        document.addEventListener('livewire:dom-ready', () => {
            Alpine.data('$form', () => ({
                title: '',
                description: '',
                image: null,
                message: ''
            }));
        });
    </script>
</body>
</html>
```
